mapper.sql: s.id, s.class_id, s.course_id, s.course_detail_id, s.course_day_num, s.schedule_date, s.schedule_type, s.course_content, s.stage_name, s.teacher_id, coalesce(u.real_name, u.nickname, u.username) as teacher_name, s.created_at, s.updated_at
mapper.insert:
insert into edu_class_schedule (class_id, course_id, course_detail_id, course_day_num, schedule_date, schedule_type, course_content, stage_name, teacher_id, created_at, updated_at) values
(#{item.classId}, #{item.courseId}, #{item.courseDetailId}, #{item.courseDayNum}, #{item.scheduleDate}, #{item.scheduleType}, #{item.courseContent}, #{item.stageName}, #{item.teacherId}, #{item.createdAt}, #{item.updatedAt})
mapper.select: select from edu_class_schedule s left join sys_user u on u.id = s.teacher_id where s.class_id = #{classId} order by s.schedule_date asc, s.id asc
select from edu_class_schedule s left join sys_user u on u.id = s.teacher_id where s.teacher_id is not null and s.schedule_type = 'CLASS' order by s.class_id asc, s.schedule_date asc, s.id asc
select count(1) from edu_class_schedule where class_id = #{classId}
